description: ROUND-2 VERIFICATION: RESOLVED. run.sh's generate_draft (lines 134-163) now distinguishes the two cases: if ARTICLE_REAL_DRAFT_PATH is non-empty but the file does NOT exist, a clearly-labeled 'generate_draft_wiring_error' entry (naming the missing path) is appended to $ARTICLE_DIR/state/failures.jsonl and a 'WIRING ERROR' line is printed to stderr, BEFORE falling through to the same boilerplate safety-net; when the path is not supplied AT ALL, neither the stderr diagnostic nor the failures.jsonl entry fires. tests/test-find003-missing-draft-path-wiring-error.sh proves both halves with a positive assertion (supplied-but-missing -> WIRING ERROR + failures.jsonl entry naming the path) and a negative control (nothing supplied at all -> no WIRING ERROR, no failures.jsonl entry) on the SAME boilerplate output. Confirmed as a genuinely new, previously-failing (against pre-fix source) test via the red-phase evidence log.

evidence.snippet:
if [ "${ARTICLE_TEST:-}" != "1" ] && [ -n "${ARTICLE_REAL_DRAFT_PATH:-}" ]; then

  ...
  printf '%s\n' "{\"ts\": \"$err_ts\", \"error\": \"generate_draft_wiring_error\", ...}" >> "$ARTICLE_DIR/state/failures.jsonl"
  echo "generate_draft: WIRING ERROR -- ..." >&2
fi
